Author: MusicManBowls
Name: Hunt Train Relay
Punchline: Posts your hunt train's finish time + per-mark respawn estimates to Discord.
Description: Watches Hunt Helper's train via its IPC. Ends manually via End Train Now, posting a Discord report sorted by the order marks actually died, with Assumed Sniped detection for named marks never seen. Also supports on-demand scouting reports with multi-scout credit. Now includes Hunt Tally, the lifetime per-mark kill counter that used to be a separate plugin - it keeps counting into its existing HuntTally.json, so upgrading loses nothing. Uninstall the standalone Hunt Tally plugin after updating.
